title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.37953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. translated_title: 自进化多智能体系统的拓扑一致性
translated_abstract: 复杂任务本质上将工作流结构、智能体职责、协作与记忆访问耦合在一起：任务区域界定职责与工具范围，跨区域依赖产生交接，所有权边界划定私有与选择性共享的记忆。现有方法可以联合优化智能体与通信结构，但这种优化本身并不要求职责、交接与记忆边界与任务依赖保持一致。我们将这一要求称为拓扑一致性。我们提出了TOCOMAS——一个拓扑一致的多智能体系统。TOCOMAS将任务图建立在工具接口之上，将兼容的任务节点组织成可复用的职责域，并推导出由依赖驱动和配置条件约束的协作，以及由边界调控的记忆可见性。在在线自进化过程中，TOCOMAS提出对智能体、协作与记忆策略的耦合变更。
tldr: 提出TOCOMAS拓扑一致多智能体系统，通过将任务图扎根于工具接口、组织可复用职责域并调控记忆边界可见性，使职责、交接与记忆边界始终与任务依赖保持一致，并在在线自进化中进行智能体、协作与记忆策略的耦合变更。
en_tdlr: Proposes TOCOMAS, a topology-coherent multi-agent system that grounds task graphs in tool interfaces, organizes reusable responsibility domains, and keeps responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries consistent with task dependencies through coupled policy changes during online self-evolution.
